title: SK Hynix bargains for chip equipment exports to its China facility in return for building a factory in US | TechCrunch
summary: SK Hynix appears to be navigating choppy U.S.-China chipmaking waters. Reuters cited its sources as saying that Solidigm wants to install more chipmaking equipment in spare space at SK Hynix’s Dalian factory in China to boost NAND chip production.
